# Tech stack

The stack this fixture's units are emanated under. Backend-only, because the
frontier here is domain units: no `layer:` states whether an entity belongs to
the UI half or the service half of a suite, so a second framework profile would
leave every one of them ambiguous (`PR-07`) and this fixture is about waves.

## Language

- **TypeScript**, end to end.
